name: WebMCP Description Benchmarks
description: Supplementary dataset for a behavioral evaluation of the four WebMCP tools exposed by the production site clouatre.ca (search_posts, get_post_markdown, get_related_posts, get_posts_by_concept). Three tasks (discover, extract, traverse) x three models (claude-haiku-4-5, glm-5.3-flash, gpt-6-luna) x five iterations were run across three site configurations (pagination baseline, response caps with progressive disclosure, and a tool-response ordering fix), 135 runs total, driven through the real document.modelContext registration in Playwright Chromium via a streamable-HTTP MCP bridge and the goose agent runtime. The final configuration holds 45/45 rubric passes with every tool payload under budget. Includes the harness and summarizer, deterministic rubric results, per-run token and tool-call JSONs, a payload token audit at three commits, and the enablement spike findings.
